title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
description: Given a string `s`, find the length of the longest substring without repeating characters.

hints.content: Use a sliding window defined by two pointers [left, right].
Track the last seen index of each character in a map.
When a repeated character is encountered, jump the left pointer to lastSeen + 1.

solution.explanation:
Sliding window with character index map. When duplicate is seen, slide left pointer past its last occurrence.
Time Complexity: O(n)
Space Complexity: O(min(m, n)) where m is character set size
